name: doc-generation
description: Outline → draft → critique-and-rewrite loop → format check. A judge ends the loop once the critique stops finding substantive issues.

phases.name: outline
phases.description: Produce a section-by-section outline from the brief.

phases.name: polish
phases.description: Draft + critique until the judge says STOP (max 5 passes).

phases.name: format-check
phases.description: Final formatting / structure pass before publish.
